title: The Story of Tetris
summary: Gaming Historian recounts how Alexey Pajitnov created Tetris in the Soviet Union and how a fight over publishing rights spanned the West, Mirrorsoft, Nintendo and the Cold War. It runs about an hour with chaptered parts.
why: HN recommends it as an excellent documentary on Tetris and its tangled licensing history.

quote.text: excellent and fascinating documentary on the history of Tetris
